tagline: Two days of roots on the farm
sector: A ticketed two day roots and Americana music festival, staged on a working farm and run by a volunteer committee.
founded_place_size: outside Burlington, Vermont; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
about: Lanternwood Folk Fest is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is outside Burlington, Vermont, and this commission covers phase 2: keepsake programme and venue wayfinding.
audience: A roots and Americana crowd broadly thirty to sixty, many of them returning regulars who keep the programme, willing to pay for something that feels made rather than mass produced.
price_positioning: Sixty five pounds a day. A considered keepsake register: photographs given real room, editorial type with a proper hierarchy, generous margins, one act to a page breathing rather than a dense fair handout, and never a near empty boutique arts brochure.

palette.name: Lantern Amber
palette.role: mandatory in the programme; optional on the signs
palette.usage: Act names and section heads on Weathered Cream, as the act name on lanternwood_programme_2025_pages.pdf; rules, as on lanternwood_programme_2023_page.pdf; the lantern of the crest, amber on lanternwood_banner_photo.jpg and on both printed pages. Never a programme ground, panel or biography text. On a sign: its solid ground, with Barn Charcoal or Laurel Deep type and arrow; or its type and arrow on a Weathered Cream, Laurel Deep, Field Green or Barn Charcoal ground.

palette.name: Field Green
palette.usage: The stage, day and set time line on Weathered Cream, as on lanternwood_programme_2025_pages.pdf, and section heads; the laurel ring of the crest, green on lanternwood_banner_photo.jpg and on both printed pages. Never a programme ground, panel or biography text. On a sign: its solid ground, with Weathered Cream or Lantern Amber type and arrow; or its type and arrow on a Weathered Cream ground.

palette.name: Weathered Cream
palette.role: mandatory in the programme; optional on the signs
palette.usage: The solid ground of every programme page, as on both printed pages and the cream canvas of lanternwood_banner_photo.jpg. On a sign: its solid ground, with Lantern Amber, Laurel Deep, Field Green or Barn Charcoal type and arrow; or its type and arrow on a Laurel Deep, Field Green or Barn Charcoal ground.

palette.name: Barn Charcoal
palette.role: mandatory in the programme; optional on the signs
palette.usage: Biographies and running text on Weathered Cream, as on both printed pages; may set the stage, day and set time line, as on lanternwood_programme_2023_page.pdf. On a sign: its solid ground, with Weathered Cream or Lantern Amber type and arrow; or its type and arrow on a Weathered Cream or Lantern Amber ground.

palette.name: Laurel Deep
palette.usage: Act names and section heads on Weathered Cream, as the act name on lanternwood_programme_2023_page.pdf; the crest's arched wordmark, as on both printed pages. Never biography text. On a sign: its solid ground, with Weathered Cream or Lantern Amber type and arrow; or its type and arrow on a Weathered Cream or Lantern Amber ground.

typography: Lanternwood Folk Fest runs on Yeseva One Regular with Source Serif 4 Regular underneath it. Step 01, the act name, is Yeseva One Regular at 42 pt on 46 pt leading with tracking at 0. Step 02, the section head, is Yeseva One Regular at 18 pt on 21 pt, tracking 0. Step 03, the biography, is Source Serif 4 Regular at 10.5 pt on 15 pt, tracking 0, set to a maximum of 65 characters a line. Step 04, the set time, stays in Yeseva One Regular at 14 pt on 17 pt, tracking 0, which is exactly one third of the 42 pt act name and is the move that makes a stage board recognisable. Yeseva One is never letterspaced at any size. Beyond these four steps the same face sets the wayfinding destination at 120 pt with a 48 pt direction line, and screen listings at 64 px on 70 px.
voice: Friendly, plain and a little handmade, the voice of a committee that runs the thing itself. Example line the brand would write: "Grab a pint, find your stage, and we will see you down the front."
brand_assets_status: No working files survive. The previous designer moved to Canada, leaving only two printed programme pages held by the printer (last year's and the year before) plus last year's printed cover. The crest has never existed as a file: it lives only as paint on the canvas banner over the main gate, photographed for reference. Fonts and colours must be inferred from the printed pages.
values: The programme is the keepsake, and the crest is how regulars recognise the festival. Both should feel handmade but properly made, worthy of the wall they end up on.

type_system.tagline: Two days of roots on the farm

scale.note: Act name. The number the set time is divided from: a 42 pt act name gives a 14 pt set time, exactly one third.
Section head. Same flared serifs as the act name, one act to a page, margins left generous.

scale.sample: A roots and Americana act the committee is glad to bring to the farm.
scale.note: Biography. The only role that leaves Yeseva One. Photographs keep their room around it.
Set time. The signature move: the clock wears the same serifs as the act above it, at exactly one third the act name size, never a sans.

type_system.signature_move: Set times are set in Yeseva One rather than a sans, at exactly one third the act name size, so every stage board and every programme page shows a clock wearing the same flared serifs as the act above it. At the 42 pt act name of step 01 that fixes the set time of step 04 at 14 pt.
rules: Never letterspace Yeseva One. Tracking stays at 0 on steps 01, 02 and 04, including negative tracking at display sizes.
Set times are always exactly one third the act name size and are always Yeseva One, never a sans.
Yeseva One Regular sets every act name, section head and wayfinding destination.
Wayfinding sets the sign destination in Yeseva One at 120 pt with the direction line at 48 pt.
Screen listings set in Yeseva One at 64 px on 70 px.
Source Serif 4 Regular is reserved for biographies at 10.5 pt on 15 pt.
Give photographs real room and keep margins generous: one act to a page breathing, never a dense fair handout and never a near empty boutique arts brochure.

palette_rules.distribution: Every ground and panel in the programme is solid Weathered Cream, as on both printed pages; photographs sit on it and no other colour forms a ground or panel. On Weathered Cream, biographies and running text are Barn Charcoal; act names and section heads are Lantern Amber or Laurel Deep (section heads may also be Field Green); stage, day and set time lines are Field Green or Barn Charcoal; rules are Lantern Amber. The crest keeps the amber lantern and green laurel ring painted on the gate banner, printed in Lantern Amber and Field Green on both printed pages. In the programme, Lantern Amber and Field Green are for type, rules and the crest only, never a ground or panel, together no more than 5% of a page's designed, non-photographic area. No supplied file shows a sign, so a wayfinding sign may take any one palette colour as its one solid ground, with type and arrow that contrast with it: on Weathered Cream, Lantern Amber, Laurel Deep, Field Green or Barn Charcoal; on Lantern Amber, Barn Charcoal or Laurel Deep; on Laurel Deep, Field Green or Barn Charcoal, Weathered Cream or Lantern Amber.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity, as every fill on both printed pages is. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph: type sits on the solid Weathered Cream ground beside or below the photograph.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the five palette hexes for type, grounds, panels, rules, arrows or icons, and no gradient, glow or metallic effect on any of them. Photographs and the crest reproduced from lanternwood_banner_photo.jpg are judged by their own checks.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep their own corrected colour and are never recoloured toward the palette: no sepia, duotone, Weathered Cream wash or Lantern Amber tint is laid over a press photo to make it look like a keepsake, and the warm late-afternoon light of lanternwood_press_photo_04.jpg is not pushed further toward Lantern Amber.
